name: Evaluations
description: Tests whether the eval framework accepts a BYOM-prefixed deployment_name for the judge model. Research suggests it likely does NOT parse the prefix (same posture as image-generation-direct).
notes: Verified regression on ai-foundry-63fhh7glaqhvw with azure-ai-evaluation installed: the eval SDK constructs the request URL as `/openai/deployments/{apim-conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry does not route → returns 400 'API version not supported'. Judge-model BYOM will require either eval-SDK changes or a Foundry URL-rewrite. Skips if EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL is unset.
